annotations.title: Inspect Solana SPL / Token-2022 Mint Security

description: Inspect a Solana SPL or Token-2022 mint account via live Solana mainnet RPC and RugCheck to detect `PermanentDelegate` drain authorities, arbitrary `TransferHook` programs, active `FreezeAuthority`/`MintAuthority`, and hidden transfer fee basis points. Read-only, non-destructive analysis (5 free calls/hour per IP or unlimited with X-API-Key). Returns JSON with `mint`, `program`, `permanent_delegate`, `transfer_hook`, `freeze_authority`, `risk_score` (0-100), and `verdict` (`PASS`, `WARN`, `BLOCK`). Use this tool for deep Solana mint extension inspection; use `analyze_token_alpha` when you also need DexScreener price, liquidity, and 24h volume.

mint.description: Base58-encoded Solana SPL or Token-2022 mint address (32-44 characters, e.g. `EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v`).

name: check_solana_token2022
